universes.description: Those of the album and of its series, without duplicates, by name.

sortKey.description:
The sort key in force, computed from the title or entered by hand (see

BibliographyEntry.description:
An entry of a bibliography: either a series, or an album without series, exactly one of the two. The
entries are an index leading to the records, which carry the contributions themselves, whole.

ChangeLogAttribute.description:
Attribute of a record changed by a modification, as the change log names it
(modele-metier/entree-du-journal-des-modifications.md). The type of the record gives it its
context: the title of
an album and the title of a series are both ChangeLogAttribute.Title.

ChangeLogChange.description:
One attribute changed by a modification: an element added (genre, contribution, visual…) has no
value before, an element removed none after.

The record under which the page of this one is addressed: the album of an edition or of a purchase intent, the publisher of

exists; `null` for any other record.

An entry of the change log (modele-metier/entree-du-journal-des-modifications.md). It carries
data, never a text: the client builds the message in the display culture in force when it presents
it (fonctionnel/presentation/langue-et-culture-d-affichage.md), and always the same message for the same entry.

ChangeLogOperation.description: Operation recorded by an entry of the change log (modele-metier/entree-du-journal-des-modifications.md).

`false` until the statistics drawn at random are computed (Phase 4): their blocks are then presented without

is refused if the impact has changed since the user confirmed it.

A file uploaded for a visual while an edition is entered (`POST /admin/visuals/pending`, form field
string UploadVisualFields.File), kept until ExpiresAt for the saving of the edition.

website.description: Where the publisher leads, having no record of its own (fonctionnel/structure-de-l-application.md).

collections.description: The names of its collections, in their order: their number is the column of the list.

editionCount.description:

(fonctionnel/regles-metier/intention-d-acquisition.md).

version.description: Version of the publisher, sent back with its deletion.

every write on its collections — sent back with any modification or deletion.

purchaseIntentCount.description: The purchase intents targeting an edition of the collection, never counted among its editions.

seriesCount.description: The series whose new editions are proposed the collection.

savedSearchCount.description: The saved searches designating the collection.

A collection of a publisher as the form of its publisher presents it: what references it, series templates, editions, purchase
intents and saved searches, which forbids its removal, counted as the impact of its deletion
(fonctionnel/regles-metier/suppression-des-entites.md).

PublisherContent.description:
Everything the user edits on a publisher, sent to create it, and sent whole to modify it: its collections are replaced
by those listed, a collection of the publisher absent from the list being removed.

collections.description: Its collections, by name, each with what references it.

version.description: Version of the publisher, the aggregate root of its collections, sent back with any modification or deletion.

PublisherForm.description:
A publisher as its administration form edits it (visuel/saisie-editeur/contenu.md), with its collections, which are entered
and saved with it, and the dates of the record, which the form presents.

website.description: Where a publisher leads, having no record of its own (fonctionnel/structure-de-l-application.md).

state.description:
Where the album stands with regard to the collection, as every list tells it
(fonctionnel/regles-metier/appartenance-a-la-collection.md#états-dun-album): in the collection, or wished for, never outside it.

oneOf.description: The edition targeted; `null` for an intent on the whole album, any edition doing.
The cover of the album (fonctionnel/regles-metier/couverture-d-un-album.md); `null` for the generic visual.

Whether the intent turns into one on the other target (fonctionnel/regles-metier/intention-d-acquisition.md): always for an intent
on the album; for an intent on an edition, only when that edition is the only one of its album.

albumVersion.description: Version of its album, sent back with its removal: the intent belongs to the aggregate of its album.

PurchaseIntentAdminListItem.description:
A purchase intent as a row of the list of the administration presents it (visuel/listes/liste-par-liste.md): the album it
targets, with its membership of the collection, and what it targets, the whole album or one of its editions.

A page of the public list of the purchase intents, and the records its filters designate, named as the lists name them, for
the screen to present them without another request.

oneOf.description:
The records the form added on the spot (a publisher), created with the edition: PublisherId cites one by its
key. `null` for none, as in what a reading returns.

The edition an intent targets, entered with the minimum of fields: those of the published edition,
without the traits of the copy once owned (condition, second hand, dedication, freeness,
acquisition, personal reference and notes —
fonctionnel/regles-metier/intention-d-acquisition.md#réalisation-dune-intention).

editionId.description: The edition targeted, not owned; `null` for an intent on the whole album.

PurchaseIntentForm.description: A purchase intent, on the whole album or on one of its editions.

PurchaseIntentItem.description:
A purchase intent, which has no record of its own: the record of its album presents it, with the album
or the edition it targets (fonctionnel/structure-de-l-application.md).

state.description: The possession of the album, never outside the collection for an album targeted.

oneOf.description: The edition targeted; `null` for an intent on the whole album.

publisherWebsite.description:
Where the publisher of the edition targeted leads (fonctionnel/presentation/libelle-d-une-edition.md); `null` when unknown,
or for an intent on the whole album.

oneOf.description:
The cover of the album among all its editions, the list being a context of documentary base
(fonctionnel/regles-metier/couverture-d-un-album.md); `null` for the generic visual.

PurchaseIntentListItem.description:
An intent as a row of the public list of the purchase intents presents it, which leads to the record of the album targeted
(fonctionnel/structure-de-l-application.md): always as an intent, with the album or the edition it targets
(fonctionnel/regles-metier/intention-d-acquisition.md).

albumVersion.description: Version of the album, sent back with any write on its intents.

PurchaseIntentsForm.description:
The purchase intents of an album, which belong to the aggregate of the album: the version sent
back with any write on them is the album's.

albumsOutsideCollection.description: Albums outside the collection, neither owned nor wished for (fonctionnel/regles-metier/appartenance-a-la-collection.md#états-dun-album).

seriesWithoutStatus.description: Series whose status is not set.

subUniverses.description: Universes that have a parent universe.

The number of records of each type, with the detail the home page of the administration gives of each
(visuel/administration/contenu.md, Les fiches), which its menu also presents (visuel/administration/en-tete-et-menu.md).

RecordLabelAlbumLabel.description: What the label of an album is built from (fonctionnel/presentation/libelle-d-un-album.md).

RecordLabelApplicationSettingsLabel.description: The single setting of the application, which its type of record suffices to label.

RecordLabelAuthorLabel.description:
What the main identifier of an author is built from
            (fonctionnel/presentation/tri-et-navigation-par-initiale.md#artistes).

RecordLabelEditionLabel.description: What the label of an edition is built from (fonctionnel/presentation/libelle-d-une-edition.md), with the label of its album.

RecordLabelNameLabel.description: A record labelled by its name alone: series, publisher, genre, universe.

RecordLabelPublisherCollectionLabel.description: A publisher collection, with its publisher.

RecordLabelPurchaseIntentLabel.description: The target of a purchase intent: its album as a whole, or one of its editions.

RecordType.description:
Type of a record written by the application, as the change log names it
(modele-metier/entree-du-journal-des-modifications.md).

values.description:
The value of each variable given one, by its name (ignoring case and accents, as variables are told
apart), written as the values of the criteria; the others keep their default value.

ReplaySavedSearchRequest.description: The replay of a saved search, whose results are paginated by the query of the request.

name.description: Under which the search is offered in the consultation, unique ignoring case and accents.

entity.description: The entity the search returns, whose schema the criteria follow.

criteria.description:
What the records must satisfy, as for an advanced search; its constants are the default values of the
variables that replace them.

variables.description: The constants of the criteria replaced by a variable, whose value is asked at replay.

SavedSearchContent.description:
Everything the administrator edits on a saved search, sent to create it, and sent whole to modify it:
renaming it, changing its criteria, or the default values of its variables.

criteria.description: The criteria, each variable at its default value.

SavedSearchDetail.description:
A saved search, with what its replay asks and what preloads the form of a new search: its criteria,
with no link kept to the saved search.

version.description: Version of the search, sent back with any modification or deletion.

SavedSearchForm.description: A saved search as its administration form edits it (fonctionnel/recherche-avancee/recherches-enregistrees.md).

SavedSearchListItem.description: A saved search, as the consultation offers it to be replayed (fonctionnel/recherche-avancee/recherches-enregistrees.md).

location.description: JSON pointer (RFC 6901) to the constant of the criteria it replaces.

defaultValue.description: The constant it replaces, written as the values of the criteria.

SavedSearchVariable.description: A variable of a saved search, whose value is asked at replay.

SearchComparison.description: The comparisons of a criterion, each available according to the type of its data (fonctionnel/recherche-avancee/comparaisons.md).

SearchCondition.description:
A condition of the advanced search (fonctionnel/recherche-avancee/recherche-avancee.md), on the records of an entity: a
criterion on one of its data, a link to related records, or a combination of conditions.

field.description: Key of the data, among those the schema describes for the entity (SearchFieldDescription).

values.description:
None for SearchComparison.IsSet and SearchComparison.IsNotSet, two for
SearchComparison.Between, at least one for SearchComparison.IsOneOf and
SearchComparison.IsNoneOf, one otherwise. Each is written according to the type of the
data: a text as is; a number in decimal digits; a date as `yyyy`, `yyyy-MM` or
`yyyy-MM-dd`, its precision being that of the comparison; a boolean as `true` or
`false`; a member of an enumeration by its name; a record by its identifier.

matchCaseAndAccents.description:
For a text only: compares it respecting case and accents, ignored otherwise
(fonctionnel/recherche-avancee/comparaisons.md).

SearchConditionSearchCriterion.description: A comparison of one data of the entity to one or several values.

field.description: Key of the data of the entity, among those the schema describes (SearchFieldDescription).

comparison.description: One of the IReadOnlyList<SearchComparison> SearchFieldDescription.DataComparisons of the data.

other.description:
The data compared to: of the same type, of the same enumeration for an enumeration, of the same entity for
a record; any date for a date.

matchCaseAndAccents.description: For texts only: compares them respecting case and accents.

oneOf.description:
For dates only, and required: the precision both are compared at, each covering the whole period it is
known to at that precision (e.g. a date known to the year covers its twelve months).

SearchConditionSearchDataComparison.description:
A comparison of one data of the entity to another data of the same type (fonctionnel/recherche-avancee/comparaisons.md), of
the same record or of a record it leads to: it holds only if both data are set and the comparison
establishes it.

SearchConditionSearchGroup.description: Conditions combined by AND or by OR; empty, AND holds for every record and OR for none.

link.description: Key of the link, among those the schema describes for the entity (SearchLinkDescription).

oneOf.description:
What the same related record must satisfy; `null` for any related record (e.g. "has a series", "has
at least one edition").

How many related records must satisfy the condition, for a link to several records only; `null`
for a link to one record, which must exist and satisfy it.

SearchConditionSearchLink.description:
A condition on the records related by a link of the model (fonctionnel/recherche-avancee/liens-entre-entites.md), which
may itself follow further links: the path of the criteria it holds.

SearchConditionSearchNot.description: Holds for every record the condition does not establish.

SearchDataType.description: Type of a data, which determines its comparisons and how its values are written.

SearchEntityDescription.description: An entity the advanced search returns, with the data and the links its criteria can follow.

comparisons.description: Those its type allows, "is set" and "is not set" for an optional data only.

dataComparisons.description:
Those its type allows to another data of the same type (SearchDataComparison); none for a type
that cannot be compared so.

oneOf.description: For a date: the finest precision it is known to (a partial date, a year).

enumeration.description: For an enumeration: its name, whose members a client localizes.

members.description: For an enumeration: the names of its members, in their business order.

oneOf.description: For a record: the entity it is one of.

SearchFieldDescription.description: A data of an entity, which a criterion compares.

isMultiple.description: Whether it leads to several records, its condition then being quantified.

SearchLinkDescription.description: A link of the model from an entity to related records (fonctionnel/recherche-avancee/liens-entre-entites.md).

SearchOperand.description: The other data of a SearchDataComparison.

SearchQuantifier.description: How many of the records related by a link to several records must satisfy its condition.

SearchSchema.description:
What the advanced search can query, for the clients to build its form in the terms of the business
(fonctionnel/recherche-avancee/recherche-avancee.md): its keys are localized by the client, never shown as they are.

name.description: What the value asked at replay is named after, unique in the search ignoring case and accents.

location.description:
JSON pointer (RFC 6901) to the constant in the criteria, as they are written in JSON: one of the
`values` of a criterion or of a quantifier, e.g. `/conditions/1/values/0`.

SearchVariableContent.description: A constant of the criteria replaced by a variable.

list presents of the records it is filtered on.

overview.description: Its pile of covers and the number of its albums, as the consultation presents them.

albumsInCollectionCount.description:

(fonctionnel/regles-metier/appartenance-a-la-collection.md).

isComplete.description: Whether the user deems the series complete: « Complète », otherwise « À compléter ».

version.description: Version of the series, sent back with its deletion.

(none yet, or, being created, still exactly those of the series chosen before); otherwise it keeps its own.

What the entry form of an album holds when a series is chosen: whether the album is being created, the series whose

contributions (fonctionnel/regles-metier/initialisation-des-contributions-depuis-la-serie.md).

overview.description: The series as a whole, its albums the list does not present included.

roles.description: The roles credited on the series itself; empty for an author credited on its albums only, and in a universe.

albums.description: The albums of the series the list presents, in the order of the series.

albums.

albumsInCollectionCount.description:

(fonctionnel/regles-metier/appartenance-a-la-collection.md).

Everything the user edits on a series, sent to create it, and sent whole to modify it (the

contributions.description: The authors of the series: its template contributions.

publisherCollectionId.description: Requires PublisherId, and must belong to that publisher.

references.description: The records the content references by their identifier, named for the form to present them.

oneOf.description: With its publisher, the one it belongs to.

universes.description: Each with its ancestors, a universe being presented with them (visuel/saisie-serie/contenu.md).

authors.description: The authors of its contributions, each once.

universes.description: Each with its ancestors, a universe being presented with them.

publisher.description: The publisher and the collection of the template, together.

SeriesMergeRequest.description:
The merge of two series: each data kept, of the one or the other, the publisher and its collection together, of the same
series (modele-metier/relations-et-cardinalites.md); and each genre, universe and contribution held by one series only,
retained or discarded.

albumCount.description: Every album of the series, omnibuses and special issues included.

firstVolumeCovers.description:
Those of its first int SeriesOverview.FirstVolumeCount regular volumes at most — neither
omnibus nor special issue —, in the order of the series
(fonctionnel/regles-metier/ordre-des-albums-dans-une-serie.md), `null` for a volume without cover. A place
beyond them is a generic card (visuel/fiche-serie/).

SeriesOverview.description:
What represents a series: the number of its albums, and the covers of its first volumes, whether the
list presents them or not (e.g. a series an author is credited on itself only).

oneOf.description: `null` for an empty collection, or an edition of the day without cover: the theme then keeps its own colours.

SpotlightColors.description:
The colours of the day (visuel/dashboard/la-couverture-du-jour.md): those of the cover of the edition in the spotlight
of the day, which the theme « La couverture du jour » paints every page with, in the consultation as in the
administration.

publisherWebsite.description:
Where the publisher of the edition leads, from the label of the edition (fonctionnel/presentation/libelle-d-une-edition.md);
`null` when unknown, the publisher being then no link.

oneOf.description: The first cover of the edition; `null` without any, the generic visual standing in for it.

summary.description: The summary of the album, which the theme may shorten.

SpotlightEdition.description: The owned edition in the spotlight of the day, the same for every display of the day.

sortKey.description: `null` for a blank title, which has none.

TitleSortKey.description:
The sort key the domain computes from a title, which an entry form shows in its automatic mode while the title is
typed (fonctionnel/presentation/tri-et-navigation-par-initiale.md#calcul-et-stockage-de-la-clé-de-tri).

ancestors.description:
Its ancestors, from the top of the hierarchy down to its parent: the depth of its row, and what names it when its parent is
not on the page (a search, a page that begins below it).

albumCount.description:
Its albums, those of its sub-universes included (fonctionnel/regles-metier/hierarchie-des-univers.md), through their series
too (fonctionnel/regles-metier/genres-et-univers-d-un-album.md): those the list of the albums filtered on it finds.

seriesCount.description: Its series, those of its sub-universes included: those the list of the series filtered on it finds.

version.description: Version of the universe, sent back with its deletion.

UniverseAdminListItem.description:
A universe as a row of the list of the administration presents it (visuel/listes/liste-par-liste.md), the list following
the hierarchy: each universe followed by its sub-universes.

ancestors.description: From the top of the hierarchy down to its parent; empty for a universe at the top.

tree.description:
The whole tree of its universe at the top of the hierarchy, itself included, in the order of the hierarchy: each universe
followed by its sub-universes, siblings by name; each says its parent, which places it in the tree, and what is attached
to it as its own record presents it.

works.description:
Its series and albums, those of its sub-universes included (fonctionnel/regles-metier/hierarchie-des-univers.md), presented
as the bibliography of an author: the series and the albums without series together, by sort key; a series attached itself
with all its albums, a series attached through some of its albums only with those. Nobody being credited on a universe, no
entry has roles.

UniverseDetail.description:
The record of a universe in the consultation (fonctionnel/structure-de-l-application.md, visuel/fiche-univers/): whole,
without filter, like every record.

oneOf.description: Its parent with the ancestors of the parent, as the form presents it; `null` at the top.

version.description: Version of the universe, sent back with any modification or deletion.

UniverseForm.description: A universe as its administration form edits it.

ancestors.description: From the top of the hierarchy down to the parent; empty for a universe at the top.

UniverseInHierarchy.description:
A universe with the chain of its ancestors, each leading, like the universe itself, to its record
(fonctionnel/structure-de-l-application.md).

UniverseInTree.description:
A universe of the tree on the record of a universe (visuel/fiche-univers/contenu.md): its place in the tree, by its parent,
none at the top, and the numbers of series and albums its own record presents, its own sub-universes included.

parentName.description: The name of the parent universe; `null` for a universe at the top of the hierarchy.

version.description: Version of the album the form was read at.
Version of the setting the form was read at.
Version of the author the form was read at.

albumVersion.description: Version of the album the form was read at.

visuals.description: The visuals of the edition as entered (EditionVisualEntry); none, its visuals left as they are.

version.description: Version of the genre the form was read at.

publisherVersion.description: Version of the publisher the form was read at.

version.description: Version of the publisher the form was read at.
Version of the search the form was read at.
Version of the series the form was read at.

parentId.description: Its parent: an existing universe, or the key of the parent the panel created on the spot.

version.description: Version of the universe the form was read at.

oneOf.description: The parent created on the spot, if any, created with the universe (NewRecords).

VisualArrangement.description: The place of one visual in an arrangement.

maxFileSizeBytes.description: Heaviest file accepted for a visual.

pendingLifetime.description: How long a pending visual is kept for the saving of its edition.

VisualLimits.description: What the entry of the visuals announces, which api alone checks (`GET /admin/visuals/limits`).

VisualType.description:
Type of visual attached to an edition (Type de visuel), its values following the fixed display
order of fonctionnel/regles-metier/ordre-des-visuels-d-une-edition.md.
